news.title: Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Limited Announces Resignation of Harsha Hitesh Bhansali as Non-Executive, Independent Director, Effective January 7, 2026
news.body: Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Limited announced that Mr. Harsha Hitesh Bhansali, Non-Executive, Independent Director, has tendered his resignation from the Board of Directors of the company with effect from January 7, 2026, due to personal reasons.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. Of these new board members, 2 were independent directors. The company's board is composed of: 3 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Independent Director Reena Sharma was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Lack of board continuity.

news.title: Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Limited Announces Resignation of Nitinkumar Bhawarlal Parmar as Non-Executive, Independent Director, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Limited has announced that Mr. NitinKumar Bhawarlal Parmar (DIN: 07551010), Non-Executive, Independent Director has tendered his resignation from the Board of Directors of the Company with effect from January 05, 2026 due to personal reasons. The resignation letter shall be placed before the Board of Directors in the upcoming Board Meeting for its consideration and formal acceptance in accordance with the aforementioned regulation.

news.title: Ramchandra Leasing & Finance Limited Approves the Resignation of Pramod Kumar Gadiya as Non-Executive Director, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: Ramchandra Leasing & Finance Limited approved the resignation of Mr. Pramod Kumar Gadiya, Non-Executive Director of the Company with effect from January 5, 2026.
